signature: SUBROUTINE ZLASET( UPLO, M, N, ALPHA, BETA, A, LDA )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies the part of the matrix A to be set.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part is set. The lower triangle is unchanged.
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part is set. The upper triangle is unchanged. Otherwise:  All of the matrix A is set.

params.name: m
params.reference: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of A.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of A.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: All the offdiagonal array elements are set to `ALPHA`.

params.name: beta
params.reference: All the diagonal array elements are set to `BETA`.

params.name: A
params.reference:
On entry, the m by n matrix A. On exit, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $1 \le i \le m$, $1 \le j \le n$, $i \ne j$;

$$
A(i,i) = \mathrm{BETA} , 1 \le i \le \min (m,n)
$$

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.
